import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import FeatureUnion
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/"
SUBMISSION_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}submission.csv"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

print(f"Loaded {len(train_df)} training rows, {len(test_df)} test rows")

label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_train = train_df[label_cols].values
X_train_raw = train_df["comment_text"].values
X_test_raw = test_df["comment_text"].values


def clean_tokens(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("_", " ")
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text if text else ""


train_texts = [clean_tokens(x) for x in X_train_raw]
test_texts = [clean_tokens(x) for x in X_test_raw]

# Create a FeatureUnion with TF-IDF on word level (1-2 ngrams) AND character level (2-3 ngrams)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    tokenizer=lambda x: x.lower().replace("_", "").split(),
    min_df=2,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=100000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b[a-z]{2,}\b",
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 3), min_df=1, max_features=20000, sublinear_tf=True
)

feature_union = FeatureUnion(
    [("word_tfidf", word_vectorizer), ("char_tfidf", char_vectorizer)]
)

X_train_all = feature_union.fit_transform(train_texts)
X_test = feature_union.transform(test_texts)

# Apply class weighting to handle class imbalance in toxicity labels
clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0, max_iter=5000, solver="lbfgs", n_jobs=-1, class_weight="balanced"
    )
)
X_final_train, X_validation, y_final_train, y_validation = train_test_split(
    X_train_all, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

clf.fit(X_final_train, y_final_train)

y_pred_val = clf.predict_proba(X_validation)
scores = []
for i in range(6):
    try:
        col_auc = roc_auc_score(y_validation[:, i], y_pred_val[:, i])
        scores.append(col_auc)
    except Exception:
        scores.append(0.5)
validation_score = np.mean(scores)
print(f"Validation Score (mean column-wise ROC AUC): {validation_score:.4f}")

test_predictions = clf.predict_proba(X_test)
pred_probs = test_predictions[:, :6]

output_data = sample_sub.copy()
output_data["id"] = test_df["id"]
output_data["toxic"] = pred_probs[:, 0]
output_data["severe_toxic"] = pred_probs[:, 1]
output_data["obscene"] = pred_probs[:, 2]
output_data["threat"] = pred_probs[:, 3]
output_data["insult"] = pred_probs[:, 4]
output_data["identity_hate"] = pred_probs[:, 5]

output_data.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully!")
print(f"Final Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {validation_score:.4f}")
